messages:
maria: Heads up — I just noticed we missed pages for a live customer complaint at 11:03 UTC. I saw webhooks spike and then silence. No PD pages went out. Anyone else seeing this?

ajay: I saw errors in notify-broker logs around 11:02-11:06. 429s and a few 502s to the outbound gateway. Could be rate-limiting from the new routing rule we rolled last night.

maria: Ugh. That window coincides with a canary deploy. Customer impact: two support tickets and a live chat escalated. They waited >15m for a response.

kelly: copying logs — grep on notify-broker: ```
2026-03-15T11:02:58Z notify-broker ERROR outbound.push failed status=429 retry_after=30ms route=route-b
2026-03-15T11:03:01Z notify-broker WARN queue_delay=1200ms backlog=340
2026-03-15T11:03:05Z notify-broker ERROR pd-webhook deliver status=502 body="upstream reset"
```

jorge: looks like the broker started rejecting after hitting a token-based rate limit. The new route (route-b) has a lower concurrency pool.

maria: Incident bot should have escalated to phone if PD didn't ACK. Did the incident-bot attempt retries?

incident-bot: system: Incident 32517 attempted 3 webhook deliveries to PagerDuty (service: oncall-core). Last response: 502. No acknowledgement received. Fallback policy: escalate to "notify-bridge" after 3 failed attempts. Action taken: enqueued fallback, but delivery failed with 429 at 11:03:07.

ajay: Huh — notify-bridge fallback itself is behind the broker we changed. So both primary and fallback share the same congested path. Bad coupling.

kelly: For immediate mitigation I manually triggered the old passthrough route so outbound goes direct to PD from the gateway. Can someone confirm phone pages went out after that? :phone:

ops-bot: system: Manual override applied by kelly at 11:10 UTC — route set to passthrough/legacy for service oncall-core.

maria: Confirmed — manual page hit. PagerDuty shows phone escalation at 11:11. Support responded.

jorge: Next steps: 1) revert the routing change for route-b until we have proper throttling/queueing, 2) add an isolated fallback path that does NOT share the same broker pool, 3) postmortem and feature flag for routing changes during canaries.

ajay: I'll add a quick guard in notify-broker: if webhook->PD returns 5xx or 429, and fallback route uses same pool, skip fallback and escalate to phone via direct gateway.

kelly: I'll own the immediate revert and open a rollback PR with the canary tags. Will also add a runbook blurb: "if notify-broker 429 spike, flip passthrough and notify oncall by phone."

maria: Please also surface customer impact in the incident report: support ticket IDs #4532, #4533, chat transcript attached to ticket. We had ~12 minutes without proactive contact.

jorge: Note for postmortem: add synthetic PD health checks that exercise both primary and fallback paths, and an integration test that simulates PD 5xx to ensure phone escalation triggers.

maria: For timeline: root detection 11:03, manual override 11:10, oncall contact 11:11, mitigation confirmed 11:12. I'll start the incident doc and tag SRE/Platform.

ajay: Quick debug snippet I ran: ```bash
# reproduce PD 502 in staging
curl -X POST -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d @payload.json https://staging-notify-broker/_deliver | jq .status
```

kelly: Good. Also let's add an alert rule: if notify-broker outbound_5xx_rate > 5% for >1m, auto-promote passthrough route and page eng-sre immediately.

maria: Thanks team. Postmortem owners: maria (incident lead), ajay (notify-broker), kelly (routing), jorge (fallback design). I'll create the incident channel and invite the customers-liaison.

incident-bot: system: Incident thread created: #incident-32517. Reminder: include timeline, impact, mitigation, root cause hypothesis, and action items.

maria: tagging for visibility @here :eyes: — adding to the incident tracker now.
